_meta.purpose: Values needed by the results dashboard that are NOT present in results/metrics/*.json or results/carbon_validation/*.json. This file supplies only (a) pre-audit baselines for the before/after table, (b) leakage-audit statistics, (c) the external Global Forest Watch reference, and (d) static text from the paper. Every value is cited in _sources. VERIFY THIS FILE before the UI is built.
_meta.no_post_audit_metrics_stored: This file contains NO post-audit (current) segmentation, area or carbon metric values. Every 'after' number the dashboard shows — segmentation mean +/- sd, area predicted/reference/ratio, carbon tCO2 — is read at build time from results/metrics/seed_runs.json, results/deforestation/baseline_unet_area_summary.json and results/carbon_validation/carbon_estimates.json. Prose notes here name no current metric values; they point to the source arrays instead.

header.title: An Integrated Pipeline for Forest-Loss Detection and Vegetation-Density-Aware Carbon-Emission Estimation from Bi-temporal Sentinel-2 Imagery
header.region: Wayanad Plateau, Western Ghats, Kerala, India
header.positioning: An end-to-end pipeline from two dated Sentinel-2 composites to a hectares-lost and a tonnes-CO2 figure, plus a calibrated NDVI→carbon regression that replaces a fixed 3-bin scheme. The contribution is the integrated, audited pipeline and the carbon upgrade — not a novel segmentation architecture.

segmentation_context.model: plain U-Net (7,764,481 parameters; no attention, no pretrained encoder)
segmentation_context.carry_forward_checkpoint: seed 43 (median best validation Dice of seeds 42/43/44)
segmentation_context.model_selection_rule: The carry-forward checkpoint is the seed with the median best VALIDATION Dice. Test metrics were never used to select.
segmentation_context.attention_note: An Attention U-Net with an ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV2 encoder was also trained under an identical schedule and did not improve on the plain U-Net. Per-seed figures for both models are in results/metrics/seed_runs.json. This is not an architecture comparison and no significance claim is made.
segmentation_context.iou_note: Strict pixel IoU is primary. Tolerance IoU dilates the Hansen GFC ground truth by one 30 m cell (7x7 window, +/-3 px at the 10 m GSD) for the intersection term while keeping the strict undilated union, because 30 m labels structurally penalise a prediction that is correct but offset by less than a GFC cell. Tolerance IoU is always shown alongside strict IoU, never instead of it.

leakage_audit.headline: A self-run leakage audit found that 50% of validation and test patches contained training pixels; it was fixed, and the corrected metrics are lower.
leakage_audit.mechanism: The training split adds stride-128 overlapping 256x256 crops. Each crop was assigned to a split using only the 512 px super-block containing the crop's top-left corner. A crop offset 128 px from a block boundary extends into the neighbouring block; where that neighbour was a validation or test block, 128 px strips of held-out territory were used as training data.
leakage_audit.found_by: scripts/verify_no_leakage.py — a self-written check that reads only the recorded pixel origin and size of every patch from data/processed/index.csv and does independent rectangle intersection (does not reuse the split logic it audits).
leakage_audit.fix: build_dataset.py now keeps an overlap crop only if its ENTIRE 256x256 footprint lies inside train-assigned blocks; a crop touching any validation/test block is dropped, not reassigned. The canonical grid, block-to-split assignment, normalisation statistics and the val/test patches are byte-identical before and after (verified by hash).

metrics_before.note: Pre-audit, single training run, leaked split. Tolerance IoU and seed spread did not exist yet, so only single scalars are available.

leakage_audit.metrics_after_pointer: The 'after' column of the before/after table is read live by the dashboard from results/metrics/seed_runs.json (segmentation, mean +/- sd), results/deforestation/baseline_unet_area_summary.json (area) and results/carbon_validation/carbon_estimates.json (carbon) — it is NOT stored here, to avoid a second copy that could drift.
leakage_audit.run_count_caveat: The pre-audit column is a SINGLE training run (commit c9947eb); the post-audit column is the MEAN +/- SD over 3 seeds (42, 43, 44). The two columns therefore differ in run count as well as in split cleanliness, so the drop from the pre-audit figures to the post-audit means is NOT entirely attributable to the leakage fix: part of it is ordinary run-to-run variation, of the order of the post-audit seed standard deviation shown in the same row. The dashboard must render this caveat alongside the before/after table.

seed_variance_note: Run-to-run spread across the 3 seeds is comparable in magnitude to the effects being measured, so headline segmentation metrics are reported as mean +/- sd across seeds 42, 43 and 44 rather than as single-run values. See results/metrics/seed_runs.json for per-seed values.
overfitting_note: Best validation Dice is reached within the first few epochs, regardless of the 80-epoch schedule length (see the per-seed best_epoch array in results/metrics/seed_runs.json). This is a direct consequence of 261 training patches at a ~0.3% positive-pixel prevalence: there is little signal to fit before the model starts memorising.
change_detection_note: The model under-predicts the deforested area on the held-out test region — the predicted hectares figure sits well below the Hansen GFC reference. The dashboard reads the predicted and reference hectares and their ratio live from results/deforestation/baseline_unet_area_summary.json (regions.test_only) and must display them side by side with the ratio stated. The predicted figure is not a validated area.

carbon_reference_gfw.source: Global Forest Watch, Wayanad district dashboard (UMD/Hansen tree-cover loss + the Harris et al. 2021 global forest carbon-flux model, 30% canopy threshold)
carbon_reference_gfw.implied_emission_factor_derivation: 2.54 Mt CO2e / 3.82 kha = 665 t CO2e/ha, a direct ratio of the two published GFW totals for the same query. An earlier draft (commit c9947eb) reported ~638 t CO2e/ha; that figure divided each total by a different assumed year count for 2001-2023 (CO2 by 23, area by 22) before taking the ratio, which is an arithmetic artifact. The GFW totals (3.82 kha, 2.54 Mt CO2e) are unchanged between the two drafts; only the per-hectare derivation was corrected. 665 is the figure used everywhere from commit 82f6948 onward.
carbon_reference_gfw.pools_and_gases: all carbon pools (above- and below-ground biomass, deadwood, litter, soil) and all gases (CO2, CH4, N2O), as gross committed emissions
carbon_reference_gfw.study_factor_basis: GFC reference area: regression-exponential 94,273 tCO2 over 237.4 ha; aboveground carbon and CO2 only
carbon_reference_gfw.scope_difference: This study estimates aboveground carbon and CO2 only. Belowground biomass, deadwood, litter and soil carbon, and non-CO2 gases, are all excluded. That is why the study's ~397 tCO2/ha is ~60% of GFW's ~665 tCO2e/ha all-pools figure — the difference is scope, not error.

carbon_calibration_label: The NDVI→carbon regression is calibrated on 8 published Western-Ghats field-inventory aboveground-carbon anchors (Padmakumar et al. 2018; Kothandaraman et al. 2020; Jose et al. 2025 as an unfitted cross-check), NOT a pixel-aligned biomass raster. r2 describes curve fit on the 8 anchors, not held-out predictive accuracy.
limitations: Single sensor — Sentinel-2 only; no Landsat or SAR fusion.
Single study region — one ~848 km2 tile of the Wayanad plateau.
One two-year window — Jan–Apr 2019 to Jan–Apr 2021.
261 training patches; a 16-patch validation set and an 18-patch test set.
30 m Hansen GFC labels evaluated against 10 m predictions (bounds achievable strict IoU).
Carbon regression is literature-calibrated (8 anchors), not fit to co-located biomass plots.
Aboveground carbon and CO2 only — no belowground / deadwood / litter / soil pools, no non-CO2 gases, no regrowth credit.
Committed-emission accounting; a fixed 2019–2020 window compared against GFW's 22-year average.
Run-to-run seed standard deviation on test IoU is 0.016–0.023 — hence metrics are reported as mean +/- sd.

figures.caption: Held-out test patches — Sentinel-2 T+1 false colour / Hansen GFC ground truth / predicted probability. Carry-forward U-Net (seed 43).
Region-wide predicted forest loss (yellow) and the hit / miss / false-alarm agreement map against Hansen GFC.
Predicted vs Hansen GFC hectares lost, per split. 10 m GSD, 0.01 ha per pixel.
NDVI → aboveground carbon density: 3-bin baseline, linear fit, and exponential fit (primary), over 8 literature anchors.
